revision_semantics: PROPOSE new root revision1 stores AdmissionPayload. Later events reference original admission digest; source refs for executable use target exact VERIFIED event revision, whose owner resolves the immutable original payload. No version1 invented for existing event/audit/close rows.

events.body_rule: family matches root; supersedes_ref required-nullable exact same-family predecessor previously verified head; missing required core facts remains common draft; incomplete eligibility may propose BLOCKED with explicit null facts.

admission_ref targets this root PROPOSE revision1; digest exact; expected head1; current actor/independent human/current bounded source trust validated; eligibility must SUPPORTED. Credential authenticity requires null reviewer_credential_ref plus trusted issuer operator; other verification requires current matching credential.
exact current head+CAS; top-level nonblank reason required; evidence refs current/custodied; terminal source never revived.
Internal owner event only, atomic with successor VERIFY; same family/subject/purpose lineage; no separate client endpoint; event retains original admission digest.

successor_activation: 15 EA1.6 authoritative. Lock all declared source families/sorted heads, CAS named predecessor head and initially empty activated_successor_ref. VERIFIED predecessor appends SUPERSEDE; previously verified REVOKED predecessor retains REVOKED head and only claims successor linkage. PROPOSE-only predecessor cannot serve as verified replacement; revoke unwanted proposal and create corrected admission with supersedes=null. Revoking successor never resurrects old source.
replay: Same immutable command+payload returns original receipt under current disclosure; not source re-execution. New effects require current trust, scope/field and source guards.
reason: CCF1 top-level reason kept verbatim; mandatory nonblank on revoke/correction, no duplicate body reason or reason-derived action/authority.
common_workflow: Source verification uses existing registered Action/draft/governance gate/work/receipt path. A gate approval is permission for exact verification, never a source VERIFY event itself. Source owner writes state once; no separate source approval engine.
